title: Change Fee Posting for Voluntary Exchanges — Crestline Tickets by Fare Brand
content:
**Call center ledger reference — Crestline Tickets by Fare Brand.** This entry governs the change fee owed for the latest voluntary, standard exchange recorded on a ticket.

## When the fee is owed

The fee is owed while no change fee entry is linked to that exchange, whether or not the customer raises it, and it is posted through the call center as one itinerary-level change fee entry linked to that exchange entry. A fee worked out at zero is not recorded, and an exchange whose fee works out at zero owes no change fee.

| Records on the ticket (hypothetical) | Change fee owed |
|---|---|
| Latest standard exchange with no change fee entry linked to it; fee works out above zero | Yes: one itinerary-level entry linked to that exchange |
| Latest standard exchange already carrying its linked change fee entry | Nothing further |
| Latest standard exchange whose fee works out at zero | Nothing owed; nothing recorded |
| Only same-day confirmed exchanges on the ticket | Not governed by this entry |

## The posting tool

`post_change_fee_ac050962` is an agent-side tool; the agent unlocks it and then calls it. It books one change fee charge on the ticket's service-fee ledger, at the itinerary level (segment 0), linked to the standard exchange entry it is charged for, at the amount given, paid through the call center. The ticket's net fee charges rise by that amount and the charge shows on the ticket's service fees at once. One call books exactly one charge.

### Parameters

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `ticket_id` | Reference number of the ticket record the fee is charged on, as returned by the ticket lookup | Identifier |
| `related_transaction_id` | Reference number of the standard exchange entry on the ticket's fare history that the fee is charged for, as returned by the fare-history lookup | Identifier |
| `corporate_account_id` | Reference number of the corporate travel agreement the ticket names, copied from the ticket record's corporate agreement field; an empty string when the ticket names no agreement | Identifier or empty string |
| `fee_amount` | The change fee charged | US dollars, a non-negative number rounded to the cent (2 decimal places) before it is passed |

### Return

A receipt with `service_id` (reference number of the new fee charge), `ticket_id`, `related_transaction_id` (the exchange entry charged for), `service_type` (always `change_fee`), `amount` (US dollars to 2 decimal places, the fee booked), `service_date` (YYYY-MM-DD) and `status` ("posted" when the charge was booked).
